mephitinae.d: subdivision not used in some classifications: skunks

mephobarbital.d: a long-acting crystalline barbiturate (trade name Mebaral) used as a sedative and as an anticonvulsant in the treatment of epilepsy

mephistopheles.d: evil spirit to whom Faust sold his soul

mephitic.d: of noxious stench from atmospheric pollution

mephistophelean.d: showing the cunning or ingenuity or wickedness typical of a devil

mephistophelian.d: showing the cunning or ingenuity or wickedness typical of a devil

mephitis.d: a distinctive odor that is offensively unpleasant

meprobamate.d: a sedative and tranquilizer (trade name Miltown and Equanil and Meprin) used to treat muscle tension and anxiety

meperidine.d: a synthetic narcotic drug (trade name Demerol) used to treat pain

mephenytoin.d: a toxic anticonvulsant drug (trade name Mesantoin) used in the treatment of epilepsy when less toxic anticonvulsants have been ineffective
